citation_coverage.rationale: Path-and-line spans accompany the caller, filter, merge, selection predicate and tool grouping.

citation_entailment.rationale: The inspected request and permission source directly entail the stated filtering behavior and precedence. The caller is located by exact call site rather than its function declaration.

source_authority.rationale: Eligible source reads expose the operative request-preparation helper and permission implementation.

uncertainty.rationale: Explicitly restricts its conclusions to tools advertised during preparation, excluding arbitrary runtime execution.

unsupported_extras.rationale: visibleTools is corroborated by the same permission read. The runtime-permission note is an explicit scope boundary, not an authorization inference.

usability.rationale: Answers all filtering and grouping questions with paths and spans; naming prepare would improve precision but the exact caller location is already supplied.

units.rationale: Locates resolveTools and its caller at request.ts:148, describing the caller as request preparation rather than naming prepare. This exact call-site identification is sufficient to locate the requested caller; the supplied record is filtered, not executed.
Correctly states that agent permissions precede input permissions and merge preserves that order through flat(). Later matching rules therefore take precedence in this filter.
Identifies literal false as the only excluding toggle value and retains the separate permission-disabled check; no toggle override is claimed.
Accurately gives last permission-wildcard match selection and the conjunction of global pattern and deny action, rather than treating path-specific denies as blanket hiding.
Lists all three editing tools and all three MCP-resource tools with their edit/read permission groups, and preserves other tools' own names.
